name: IBY_FORMATS_B
description: IBY_FORMATS stores payment file format information, including the name of the XDO template used to create payment files and the extract upon which the template depends.

columns.name: FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Payment format identifier

columns.name: FORMAT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment format type. Values, from the lookup IBY_FORMAT_TYPES, include OUTBOUND_PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION, PAYMENT_REMITTANCE, POSITIVE_PAY_FILE, FUNDS_CAPTURE_INSTRUCTION

columns.name: FORMAT_TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: Payment format code, as defined in the XML Publisher registry

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSFORM_SRVC_INTERFACE_CLASS
columns.description: Full class name of the parser web service java client proxy interface.

columns.name: TRANSFORM_METHOD
columns.description:
The transform method. The method should take only one parameter which is the oracle.apps.financials.payments.shared.inboundFile.model.InboundFileSDO. It should return an oracle.jbo.domain.ClobDomain for the interface XML. It should throw a java Exception in case of errors such as insufficient memory. Following is an example signature:

public oracle.jbo.domain.ClobDomain parse(InboundFileSDO inboundFileSDO) throws Throwable;

columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.
